name: minecraft-block-reader
description: Read blocks, block states, and entities from Minecraft structure files and world saves
author: Ewan Howell <ewanhowell5195>

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && wasm-pack build --target web --release --features wasm && node -e "const{cpSync}=require('fs');for(const f of ['minecraft_block_reader.js','minecraft_block_reader_bg.wasm','minecraft_block_reader.d.ts'])cpSync('pkg/'+f,'../wasm/'+f)"
